sourceText:
Kibby
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 11:52pm

Ingredients




1 pound ground lamb
1 pound ground beef
1 1/2 cups very fine cracked wheat
1 lg. onion
Salt
pepper
1 teaspoon heaping dried mint leaves
1/2 cup cold water

Preparation

1 Rinse wheat in cold water. Drain by squeezing through hands. Add to other ingredients and grind as many as 3 times for soft texture. Mix in 1 cup pine nuts. Melt butter to spoon over top when served. Bake at 350 degrees until done in 9" x 9" glass or metal pan.
